existing_entries.title: Chose SQLite over Postgres for local persistence
existing_entries.summary: Ledgerly is a single-user desktop app, so SQLite (stdlib, single file under ~/.ledgerly, WAL mode) was chosen instead of running a Postgres server.

files.app/db.py:
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

DB_PATH = Path.home() / '.ledgerly' / 'ledger.db'


def connect():
    DB_PATH.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL')
    return conn
